purpose: Given one exact evidence receipt from the Cousteau HA10 branch plus its frozen epistemic state, have the 17 persistent JANUS roles attack the interpretation and choose the narrowest next discriminating gate. Council output is advisory planning, never scientific evidence.

candidate_gates.description: Freeze matched pre/post-fault windows for H10S1/S2/S3 and H10N1/N2/N3, analyze RAW COUNTS first and response-corrected second, and test whether the H10S1 fault epoch predicts excess/coherence changes in S2/S3 beyond north-triplet controls.
candidate_gates.promotion_ceiling: Can classify morphology as compatible/incompatible with a triplet cross-talk mechanism; cannot prove riser failure or seabed physics.

candidate_gates.description: Locate the earliest public continuous EDH windows simultaneously available on all six HA10 hydrophones and compare the six-channel raw/corrected baseline morphology to 2013-2015 epochs without cherry-picking windows.
candidate_gates.promotion_ceiling: Can establish whether the later south-triplet morphology existed in the earliest public archive; cannot identify cause.

candidate_gates.description: Search public holdings for IDC/CTBTO calibration-flag waveform sequences or published digitizer transfer curves around March/September 2013 and bind them to channel identities without inventing unavailable internal data.
candidate_gates.promotion_ceiling: Can recover a public calibration curve/history only; absence from public archives is not absence at CTBTO.

candidate_gates.description: Continue exact native survey-track/swath recovery at the frozen HA10 coordinates and inspect bathymetry/backscatter independently of hydrophone calibration.
candidate_gates.promotion_ceiling: Can establish physical seabed geometry/coverage only where exact track/swath provenance is recovered.

candidate_gates.description: Hold interpretation and await EarthScope/CTBTO/custodian calibration and deployment-history replies if public data cannot discriminate further.
Attempt to rescue or reinterpret the frozen 119-Hz result from calibration/cross-talk findings.
candidate_gates.promotion_ceiling: FORBIDDEN; frozen 119-Hz negative remains immutable and outside the declared 1-100 Hz calibration requirement.

roles.lens: epistemic authority, claim ceiling, evidence firewall
forward causal graph and discriminating predictions
reverse causal graph, hidden parents and provenance loss
waveform, response metadata, archive chronology and signal processing
data access feasibility and exact public endpoints
adversarial falsification, confounds and failure modes
experimental design, controls and practical repeatability
archive lineage, historical source recovery and identity binding
acoustic physics, resonance versus electronics/site countermodels
whole-system synthesis, narrowest next gate and stop conditions

canonical_question: Given the exact new receipt, what is the single next gate that maximally separates instrumentation/cross-talk, persistent site/seafloor physics, archive-response limitations and ordinary background variability without changing any frozen result?
